newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan parties fail to reach holding-firm agreement.
newsitem.headline: Japan parties fail to reach holding-firm agreement.

text.p: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and its allies failed to reach an agreement on Friday on lifting a decades-long ban on holding companies, an LDP member said.
The LDP member said the three political parties would try to reach final agreement next Monday.

While the parties had basically agreed on lifting the ban, they had not agreed on guidelines on the maximum size of holding companies, a limit that would avoid an excessive concentration of business strength, he said.

An agreement among the LDP, the Social Democratic Party and the small Sakigake party would enable the government to work out necessary changes to Japan's anti-monopoly law and submit them to the current session of parliament by March 11.
Big businesses and banks have urged that the ban be lifted to help them streamline and compete with overseas rivals.
